sources.name: Cedar inspection crawler — obs (synthetic)
sources.content:
SYNTHETIC DEMO FIXTURE. Invented bench data only; no real hardware, patient, vehicle, flight, certification, qualification or release approval.

Cedar inspection crawler: J12 connects the controller to the sensor harness in an inspection-crawler control harness.
Operator note: an intermittent link interruption was reported during vibration.
This observation alone does not establish a cause or suitability for operational use.
No vibration test record accompanies this note.
Baseline revision and J12 pin mapping are not recorded.
Independent review is pending.
